name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S.-Russia Talks on Ukraine Now Involve an Oil Deal Tied to Trump Allies
changes.summary: President Vladimir V. Putin brought up a sale of Russian energy assets with President Trump’s envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, pushing a deal that raises new questions about conflicts of interest.

changes.title: US Marine Accused of Murdering Woman in Japan Hotel
changes.summary: A United States Marine is being held in Japan, accused of murder. Local police say 20-year-old Lance Corporal Devin Jacob Ballard brought a woman to a hotel before killing her and taking her wallet and backpack. Ballard has denied the allegations.

changes.title: Japan Protests After U.S. Marine Is Accused of Killing Woman in Okinawa
changes.summary: The matter threatened to revive tensions over the American military presence on the Japanese archipelago.

changes.title: Superpowers Race to Put Nuclear Reactors on the Moon
changes.summary: The United States wants a reactor on the moon by 2030. A Russian-Chinese alliance is working on one for 2036. Some leading scientists say the danger is great.

changes.title: U.K. Base Would Be Ambitious Target for ‘Gig Economy’ Warfare
changes.summary: The U.S. war in Iran unleashed small-scale attacks by local criminals or disenfranchised young men hired anonymously to target Jewish and American sites in Europe and North America, experts say.

changes.title: America’s Health Care Workforce Is in Crisis
changes.summary: —tab1962—Getty Images Dr. Jonathan Tyes once struggled to imagine a future in medicine for himself. A first-generation college student and the oldest of 10 siblings, Tyes was raised by his grandparents in Cleveland. changes.title: 11-year-old cancer survivor shares his story
changes.summary: About 500,000 cancer survivors were first diagnosed under the age of 20 in the U.S, according to the National Cancer Institute. Michael George has one boy's story.

changes.title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
changes.summary: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing. (Image credit: U.S. Coast Guard).

changes.title: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
changes.summary: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

changes.title: Trump pledges to send $90 checks to millions of seniors on Medicare
changes.summary: President Donald Trump promised on Friday to give $90 rebate checks to offset premiums for millions of U.S. seniors on Medicare, his latest pledge to send money to Americans ahead of the midterm elections.
